text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Alright, the results of the training are 
definitely showing!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: If I keep powering up at this rate—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Furioso! That was a run that showed 
unmistakable potential!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Her talent truly is among the very top 
class in Funabashi!

"Watching that run, I nodded to myself. 
Access to the JRA's training facilities 
really does make a huge difference."

My abilities have improved dramatically. 
This power will eventually lead Funabashi—

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
T-That was incredible, Furi-chan... You've 
come so far since I last saw you...

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
"She's completely transformed. At this 
rate, she might actually pull off 
defeating the Central..."

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
"Still, don't you kinda feel that way too? 
Like they've drifted a little far away..."

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
"I couldn't help wondering if maybe 
Furi-pyon had crossed over to 'that side' 
as well."
That reaction was completely unexpected.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
Going to the Central, running with friends 
there, becoming strong in a Central-like 
way...

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
Maybe she'll end up forgetting all about 
us in the future~

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so... Well, being from Funabashi 
is just a coincidence anyway...
...I understand what you're trying to say.

"Athletes and celebrities who shine on the 
global stage. People like them are—"

They don't stay tied to their local 
grounds forever. Most move on to bigger 
stages as their success grows...

Eventually, she leaves her hometown, 
drifting further and further away into the 
distance.

Furioso is just one of those people. She 
simply happened to be born in Funabashi, 
that's all...

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
"H-Huh? Is Furi-chan looking over here for 
some reason?"

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Why are you staring at me like 
that...?

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text: Furi...-chan...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: (I am—a Funabashi Umamusume.)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Simply running for Funabashi's sake, and 
battling against the Central Umamusume for 
Funabashi.)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(And if I stand up―― everyone else will 
stand with me, I know it.)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(That's right, you can do anything if you 
try. And I'll just—prove it with this body 
of mine.)

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
You're not saying... anything, are you, 
Furi-pyon?

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she's not much of a talker usually, 
either. But...

—There are no words. Furioso says nothing. 
And yet...

"Her dignified appearance seemed to be 
trying to convey something."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you very much. Thanks to 
you, I was able to make my Debut safely at 
Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
To grow even stronger, I will need to make 
better use of the Tracen facilities.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, still gonna take a lot of getting 
used to.
Yeah, I still need to get used to it

text_block_list.text:
Right now, she's merely feeling her way 
through it. And yet, look at today's run.

"Once she gets more accustomed to the 
environment, she can surely aim for the 
big races by year's end."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please tell us what our next goal 
should be.

If I were to aim for the absolute highest 
peak to elevate Funabashi's name—
choice_data_list:
Let's enter the GⅠ Zen-Nihon Junior 
Yushun.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Zen-Nippon Nisai Yushun"...! It's the 
biggest dirt race in the Junior Class, 
isn't it?

The "Zen-Nippon Nisai Yushun." A 1600m 
race held at Kawasaki Racecourse in late 
December.

Of course, Umamusume from the Central will 
also compete. As former winners, runners 
like Agnes Digital have their names on the 
roster.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
That is an impeccable... No, far beyond 
impeccable goal.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please lend me your strength. 
With our combined efforts, we will surely 
run a great race.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, let's show them what the Funabashi 
duo can do!

Yeah, let's show them the power of the 
Funabashi duo!

text_block_list.text:
The hurdle is definitely high. However, 
you never know how a match will turn out 
until you try.

The stage for our year-end showdown is 
Kawasaki. Let us challenge the Zen-Nippon 
Nisai Yushun.
